title: OpenAI API changelog — native Decisions integration in GPT-Live
text: October 15, 2026. Feature: gpt-live-1, gpt-6-luna, v1/live/sessions. Added native Decisions integration in GPT-Live. An app can act while a user is speaking or react to Live output. Native delegation lets Live call Decisions directly, or decisions can trigger on input or output transcript deltas. The linked Connect voice to Decisions guide explains that native delegation skips the app round trip. It requires the application to execute actions, verify their actual state, and report results. Reading scope: dated changelog entry and guide overview / Choose when to decide / Run actions and report results; code not executed.
